title: France to open consulate in Greenland in a ‘political signal’ amid Trump threats
summary: ‍French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot on Wednesday said France will ​open a consulate in ⁠Greenland on February 6, acting on a decision taken last year during President Emmanuel Macron's visit to the autonomous Danish territory.
